recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-32793 unless a future work group decision reintroduces a coded ImagingStudy procedure element; if that happens, this history supports using a preferred rather than extensible RadLex/LOINC-RSNA playbook binding.
issue_request: FHIR-32793 was a Published/Persuasive Imaging Integration change request asking that the binding on ImagingStudy.procedure.valueCodeableConcept be weakened from extensible to preferred because an extensible RadLex binding forced systems to translate local procedure codes whenever RadLex could express them.
initial_application: Commit 52a5df179457fea03c4c8e598133c470f4e1de38 applied the change by changing the ImagingStudy procedure binding strength from extensible to preferred in the then-current CodeableReference/coded procedure representation. Imaging Integration WGM minutes from September 2021 also recorded the action as changing the binding from extensible to preferred.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied R6 decisions changed the relevant model: FHIR-50894 removed the coded CodeableReference ImagingStudy.procedure element and modeled performed procedure through Reference(Procedure), and FHIR-53025 restored the element name ImagingStudy.procedure for that Reference(Procedure) relationship. The current source defines ImagingStudy.procedure as Reference(Procedure) with no terminology binding, and the procedure search parameter is a reference search.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is warranted because the overly strong RadLex binding is not present in the current built source, and reintroducing a preferred coded binding would conflict with later Procedure-reference modeling.
